charts.title: Kepler-13 b: orbits around Kepler-13
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-13's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-13 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Gajdoš et al. 2019 (2019RAA....19...41G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GAJDO_SCARON__ET_AL__2019): P 1.7635874737 d

charts.title: Kepler-13 b: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-13 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (75, 80, 82) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 158324245, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 13-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 13-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
